page.content:
Founder who built New Japan around Strong Style and the fighting spirit.

How Antonio Inoki connects

  • Topic: NJPW — Antonio Inoki founded New Japan Pro-Wrestling in 1972.
  • Concept: Strong Style — Inoki built Strong Style as New Japan's fighting-spirit identity.
  • Character: Tatsumi Fujinami — Fujinami was an Inoki disciple who carried Strong Style into the 1980s.

What is Antonio Inoki?

Antonio Inoki left the JWA and founded New Japan in 1972, mixing catch wrestling with the martial-arts crossover that became Strong Style and the IWGP idea.

Key threads lead to NJPW, Strong Style and Tatsumi Fujinami.
